prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: isolated transparent 2.5D pixel-art material decal for an original H5 game, not a concept UI.
Primary request: create ONE irregular thin patch of lint and adhesive dust caught on old amber packing tape, isolated on actual transparent background. Tiny pale gray-violet paper fibers, torn cream paper flecks, muted dirty gold sticky adhesive residue, dark purple micro-shadow under the fibers. The patch should be a narrow diagonal strip rising from lower-left toward upper-right, with several small gaps and frayed discontinuous ends. Keep the center translucent and sparse so the original amber tape below remains visible. Crisp controlled pixel edges and clustered shading at the same visual scale as the input amber packing tape. The source tape has a tan loose tail toward lower-left, orange roll and purple hollow center, but DO NOT draw the tape roll or reconstruct its silhouette. Draw only removable adhesive contamination as its own reusable material layer.
Input images: attached existing amber packing tape is a STYLE/MATERIAL reference only, preserve its warm orange and mauve shadow language.
Composition: centered diagonal decal occupying about 65 percent canvas width and 32 percent height, ample transparent margins, no separate decorative pieces.
Constraints: actual transparency, no ground plane, no background, no checkerboard, no bottle, no brush, no whole object, no labels, no text, no UI, no icon border, no glow, no screen mockup.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: isolated transparent 2.5D pixel-art corrosion MATERIAL DECAL for an original H5 game.
Primary request: ONE small irregular crescent-shaped copper/brass corrosion crust on actual transparent background. This is only the removable surface material to layer over the input original brass service bell. Do not draw a bell or any complete object. The corrosion has clustered dark umber pits, muted reddish brown rust, a little desaturated green gray patina tucked in pits, fine warm gold chipped rims. Crisp fine pixel shading, warm light upper-left and mauve shaded underside to match the source bell. It should read as rough metal oxidation, not dirt or soil.
Input image: original golden bell for MATERIAL/LIGHTING reference only. Keep that art's rich gold and dark purple shadows.
Composition: a compact shallow crescent spanning about 60 percent image width by 24 percent height, convex edge at bottom, transparent little holes between small islands, sparse tapered ends, no separate objects. Leave plenty of transparent padding.
Constraints: genuine transparent background. Surface decal only, no ground, no rocks, no metal plate behind it, no bell, no objects, no text, no UI, no glow, no border, no checkerboard, no screenshot.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one isolated original repair tool sprite on genuinely transparent background for a 2.5D fine-pixel H5 game.
Primary request: a small elegant precision TWEEZER, two long slender metal arms visibly meeting in a rounded joined handle at upper right, narrow open pair of bent flat tips at lower left. Clear usable steel tip gap so animation can grip a tiny paper fiber. One cohesive tool only. Warm brass ferrule detail near handle and dark mauve steel shadow, off-white cool metal reflections, modest worn gold knurl. Match the rich fine pixel texture, upper-left warm studio light and purple shadows of the attached game item reference. Tool must be practical and restrained, not ornamental, not a magic wand.
Composition: diagonal tip lower-left to joined handle upper-right, entire tool visible with transparent margin; narrow aspect shape. Tip about (20%,80%) and handle about (80%,20%). No hand, no target object.
Input image: original amber tape STYLE reference only; do not include tape.
Constraints: actual transparency, crisp pixel edge clusters, no cast shadow under tool, no floating particles, no mud, no text, no logo, no border, no background, no checkerboard, no UI.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single isolated fine-pixel repair screwdriver sprite, truly transparent background, original art for a small 2.5D H5 game.
Primary request: one practical miniature FLATHEAD SCREWDRIVER. A slender straight cool steel shaft and clearly visible flat leading tip lower-left, small brass ferrule, compact worn purple wooden handle upper-right. Copper/brass warmth on ferrule, pale steel highlight, deep mauve material shadows. Functional precision tool, restrained design, rich fine pixel texture and crisp clustered edges to match the attached golden service bell; no decoration besides a little grip ribbing on handle. Upper-left warm light.
Composition: entirely visible diagonal tool, contact blade at lower-left, handle upper-right. Long narrow shaft about two thirds of tool length, small readable flat blade. Ample transparent margin. One tool only, no hand, no target or screw.
Input image: original bell STYLE AND LIGHTING reference only, do not draw the bell.
Constraints: actual transparent background, no shadow or aura around the silhouette, no glow, no background color, no black rectangle, no text, no logo, no border, no UI, no checkerboard. This must be usable animation sprite, not a scene or concept poster.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE transparent material patch for the loose tail of an original amber packing tape game sprite.
Primary request: a compact, tangled clump of adhesive-coated dark gray paper lint, dusty mauve fibers, two curled cream paper shreds, and dull sticky amber residue. The clump is caught flat against tape, with a small lifted paper curl. It must read visibly when exported as a 45-by-17-pixel layer. Make a fairly DENSE irregular central clump, broad flat tangled silhouette, clear dark-violet contact shadow attached only to the underside edge, sparse transparent gaps, NOT a delicate thin string. Gray-violet center should contrast with the pale cream original tape tail. Width roughly three times height, lower-left to upper-right slight diagonal. Rich fine pixel-art clustered surface texture matching the input golden tape, light from upper-left. Only this small removable contamination patch, no complete tape object.
Input image: original amber tape is a STYLE reference only. Use its gold highlights and purple shadows. Do not copy the whole object or add new letters.
Composition: one patch centered with large genuine transparent margins. No disconnected floating fragments.
Constraints: transparent background and no glow; no scene, no rock, no dirt mound, no ground shadow, no full tape roll, no tools, no hand, no text, no UI, no checkerboard.
